title: MissingInfoLevelNo
description: Contract for the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch, Phase 2 — the level='No' missing-information rule. Output is a plain string|null, NOT the {text,category,discipline} object shape used by every runStage1Risks() rule — stage1MissingInfo()'s output array is an array of strings. Contract version 1.0.0.

input.description: The raw p.facts.level value. Exact match against 'No' only.

output.description: The fixed missing-info text, or null when level !== 'No'.

oneOf.const: Site level/gradient: recorded as "No" (not level) — treat as unconfirmed.
